concept.description: Labels KafkaTemplate send methods as :OutboundCall, :SideEffectCall and :BrokerSend.
concept.cypher: MATCH (lt:Type {fqn: 'org.springframework.kafka.core.KafkaTemplate'})-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method) WHERE coalesce(m.name, last(split(split(m.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) STARTS WITH 'send' OR coalesce(m.name, last(split(split(m.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) = 'executeInTransaction' SET m:SideEffectCall:OutboundCall:BrokerSend RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS ProducerMethods

MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method) WHERE m.name IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS { MATCH (m)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(ax:Type) WHERE ax.fqn IN ['org.springframework.kafka.annotation.KafkaListener'] } SET m:MessageConsumer, m.consumerKind = 'broker' RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS Listeners

constraint.description: Kafka Streams types remain in the code base although the stream topology is no longer used.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(x:Type) WHERE NOT t:Test AND x.fqn STARTS WITH 'org.apache.kafka.streams.' RETURN DISTINCT t AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, x.fqn AS Detail

constraint.description: spring.kafka.producer.acks=0 loses messages silently: use 'all' (with idempotence).
constraint.cypher: MATCH (f:Yaml:File)-[:HAS_DOCUMENT]->(:Yaml:Document)-[:HAS_MAP]->(:Yaml:Map)-[:HAS_KEY]->(:Yaml:Key {name: 'spring'})-[:HAS_VALUE]->(:Yaml:Map)-[:HAS_KEY]->(:Yaml:Key {name: 'kafka'})-[:HAS_VALUE]->(:Yaml:Map)-[:HAS_KEY]->(:Yaml:Key {name: 'producer'})-[:HAS_VALUE]->(:Yaml:Map)-[:HAS_KEY]->(k:Yaml:Key {name: 'acks'})-[:HAS_VALUE]->(v:Yaml:Scalar) WHERE v.value = '0' RETURN f AS Element, f.fileName AS Fqn, 'spring.kafka.producer.acks: 0' AS Detail
